title: Low Form-Factor Switchless Dual-Band Matching Network for RF Power Harvesting Systems
problem: A low form-factor switchless dual-band impedance matching strategy based on single resonant circuit is proposed in this paper
method: It uses a single resonant circuit (an electrical circuit tuned to specific frequencies) that matches impedances—aligning the power source and receiver for efficient energy transfer—at two different RF frequency bands without requiring electronic switches. By eliminating switches, the design stays compact and avoids the power losses that switches would introduce.
key_novelty: A single resonant circuit achieves switchless dual-band impedance matching for RF power harvesting systems.
